information_state.reason_calibration_not_invalidated: No Stage C run existed. Revision 9 is a result-independent thesis and analysis-plan decision based on source inspection and primary-source literature review. It adds no experimental evidence.

changes.before: Agentc ranked independently proposed semantic rewrites and treated ModelDowngrade as one fixed routing rule.
changes.after: Agentc is evaluated as a constrained joint execution planner over complete target-model and ordered-rewrite combinations at repeated call sites. Routing or rewriting alone is not the central novelty claim.

changes.before: Decision statistics were keyed by call site, rule, or sorted rule set, so target-model and rewrite interaction evidence could be pooled or inferred from constituents.
changes.after: Decision evidence and fallback state are keyed by versioned semantic call site and canonical complete-plan identity. A joint plan requires its own paired observations; one composed comparison updates one plan-level guard.

changes.before: Applicable proposals were ranked primarily by projected dollar savings, with cost-driver orthogonality controlling composition.
changes.after: The selector minimizes billed cost by default, or latency when configured, only among request-compatible plans with at least 20 paired observations, fresh finite estimates, a calibrated conformal upper divergence bound, positive expected net benefit, and available exposure budget. Stable tie-breaking and immutable reference fallback are frozen.

changes.before: Primary value arms compared all-on rule composition with trace-only, best-single-rule, and naive rule sequence.
changes.after: Primary arms compare fixed strong, fixed cheap, routing-only, rewrite-only on fixed strong, independently route-then-rewrite, and joint guarded planning. The main comparison is against the best admissible non-joint arm at the frozen quality margin.

changes.before: Per-rule divergence was described as an accuracy budget and composed divergence was copied to constituent rules.
changes.after: The unlabeled runtime exposes a plan-level divergence-exposure budget and explicitly does not call it task quality. The evaluation retains the separate task-equivalent damage contract where official labels exist.

outcome_blindness_assertion: Revision 9 was frozen before any admission, calibration, pilot, or confirmatory execution. No task outcome informed the title, thesis, complete-plan contract, thresholds, arms, or gate changes.
